name: Fliparchy
author: sclemance
description: Convertible tablet support: keeps iio-hyprland (auto screen/touch rotation) and squeekboard (on-screen keyboard) running, shows keyboard-toggle and rotation-lock icons only while the hardware tablet-mode switch is engaged, and persists its settings to its own ~/.config/fliparchy/config.json without touching any other config.

barWidget.description: Toggle the on-screen keyboard and rotation lock; only visible in tablet mode
